name: BanditRL.OnlineConvex.affine_support_of_finite_neighborhood
statement: theorem affine_support_of_finite_neighborhood (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hneigh : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ r : ℝ, f y = (r : EReal)) : ∃ (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ), ((a x + b : ℝ) : EReal) = f x ∧ ∀ y, ((a y + b : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f y
source_assumptions: (hneigh : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ r : ℝ, f y = (r : EReal))
